scripts.translation:
[依斯魯得衛兵]
歡迎來到依斯魯得島。

scripts.text:
[Channel Warp Official]
Izlude is a verly lively place is it not?
I am here to help make Izlude feel more smooth!
I can send you to another copy of Izlude.
Do you want to go to another copy?
scripts.translation:
[頻道傳送官員]
依斯魯得很熱鬧，對吧？
我在這裡幫大家分流，讓活動更順暢！
我可以送您去另一個頻道的依斯魯得。
您想換個頻道嗎？
